### Sydney Barber, Jack Dumanski, Tess Petrucci

rulebook: <https://cdn.svc.asmodee.net/production-daysofwonder/uploads/2025/07/7201N_TICKET2RIDEV2_RULES_EN_20250425_WEB.pdf>

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
#knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r, packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
```

What’s in the box

-   1 game board
-   225 plastic trains in 5 colors (45 each color)
-   110 train cards (12 in 8 colors and 14 wild card)
-   33 tickets
-   1 longest path bonus card
-   5 wooden scoring markers
-   1 rules booklet

# set up

-   2 players

### playing cards

```{r, cards}
####### train car pieces
# total = 225
train_cars <- list(
  list(1:45, "red"),
  list(1:45, "green"),
  list(1:45, "blue"),
  list(1:45, "yellow"),
  list(1:45, "black")
)

####### train cards
# total = 110

train_cards <- list(
  list(1:8, "pink"), 
  list(1:8, "red"), 
  list(1:8, "orange"), 
  list(1:8, "yellow"), 
  list(1:8, "green"), 
  list(1:8, "blue"), 
  list(1:8, "black"), 
  list(1:8, "white"), 
  list(1:14, "wild")
)

```

### visualization graph

```{r, network}

network <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = routes,
  directed = FALSE
)

ggraph(network, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(
      width = length,
      color = color
    ),
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_edge_color_identity() +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 3)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "Ticket to Ride: USA Route Network",
    edge_width = "Route Length"
  )
```
